messages:
Maria G.: hey team — heads up: i'm primary starting Mon 09:00 PT (3623520000) and i'm onboarding as the new oncall shadow with Priya. can we lock down shadow windows, handoff format, and any coverage gaps for the week? i still need pagerduty + 1password access.
Priya N.: congrats! i'm your secondary that week, happy to pair for first two shifts. let's do a 2hr live shadow Tues 09:00 PT and one evening active-shadow Fri 18:00 PT. also — confirm vpn + kms access before you accept pages.
Sam H.: i can cover the overnight chunk sunday midnight-08:00 PT if needed. otherwise i'm also ok swapping fri evening if you prefer.
incident-bot: INCIDENT #2026-81 — high latency on embed-store triggered 2024-10-08T02:34:12Z. Severity: sev2. Affected customers: partner-a (degraded). PagerDuty alert routed to oncall-primary.
Maria G.: we'd like to review that incident as part of onboarding. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-latency — key mitigations were kv-cache-warm and rollback to q4-variant. will add notes to my checklist.
Lucas R.: i'll run a 1hr postmortem walkthrough tues 10:00 PT — agenda: what paged, timeline, mitigations, what we should teach new oncall. i'll share the zoom + docs.
Priya N.: quick access checklist for new oncall: 1) confirm 1Password entry 'oncall-credentials' 2) verify PagerDuty login + confirm you see the oncall schedule 3) join #eng-oncall-alerts 4) ssh to jumpbox (rdw-jump) and run `rdw ops status`
Maria G.: i don't see PagerDuty notifications yet. @Olivia_SRE can you confirm PD group membership for me?
Olivia_SRE: added Maria G. to PagerDuty group `redwood-oncall` and invited to the PD schedule. also added to #eng-oncall-alerts.
Maria G.: awesome, thanks. small gap note: fri 00:00-04:00 PT doesn't have a designated shadow — @Sam H., can you take fri 00-04?
Sam H.: confirmed i can take fri 00:00-04:00 PT. i'll be remote with limited phone, ping on slack if urgent.
Maria G.: thanks. one more: what's the canonical handoff message we use? i have a short template but want the team's standard.
Priya N.: paste: ```Handoff — PRIMARY: <name> / SECONDARY: <name>
Active incidents: <incidents, severity, owners>
Known degradations: <services/regions>
Recent deploys/config: <what/when/by-who>
Scheduled maintenance: <time/impact>
Next check-in: <time>
Escalation contacts: <pager, lead, sro>```
Maria G.: perfect. i'll use that and post handoffs 15m before shift start. can someone pin the runbook in #eng-oncall? also what are the first 2 queries i should run when i get paged for latency?
Lucas R.: first queries: `kql: latency_p99 by service,model | top 50` and `kql: error_rate | where service == "embed-store"` — also curl health: `curl -s https://embed-store.internal/health` to check upstream.
incident-bot: Reminder: run `oncall-initial-checklist` playbook after first sign-in (checks PD, logs, and runbook access).
Priya N.: we'll schedule a mock page (non-prod) thursday 09:00 PT so everyone exercises PD routing & runbook steps. please mark yourself as available if you're shadowing that day.
Maria G.: i'll complete 1Password & VPN steps tonight and confirm. thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
